rules.statement: A contract of sale of land between Muslims is governed by the general law—the Roman-Dutch Law and the legislation applicable to such a transaction. Donations involving fidei commissa are excluded from the scope of Muslim Law, making them subject to Roman-Dutch Law.
rules.supporting_quote: "The sale by Mohideen, his wife and two sons to the 2nd defendant, is therefore not a transaction to which the Muslim Law applies, but one which is governed by the Roman-Dutch Law."
